General Vector Drawing — Free Browser-Based SVG Editor

General-purpose vector drawing for illustrations, icons, and freeform diagrams. Full canvas with grouping, layers, snapping, and SVG export. Switch to Electrical, UML, or Floorplan for domain-specific symbol libraries.

What you can do

  • Freeform vector drawing — lines, shapes, text, and imported images
  • Layer management with visibility toggle and element locking
  • Group and ungroup with nested group support
  • Snap-to-grid and snap-to-object for precise placement
  • Export as SVG or JSON
